summary: Zymeworks Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Board authorized a $125.0 million share repurchase program (2026 Share Repurchase Program). The previous 2025 program, also $125.0 million, was terminated after repurchasing 4,197,553 shares at an average price of $24.36, totaling $102.3 million. No specific price or premium is set; repurchases will occur in open-market or negotiated transactions. The company combined its cash and anticipated $440.0 million in regulatory milestones to fund operations beyond 2028. Watch for execution pace and any impact of milestone delays.
